steps.code:
# Let's parse the songs from the note content and search for the first song
note_content = "# Songs for Spotify Playlist\nThe Ghosts of Our Past by Mia Sullivan\nThe Fading Light of Memory by Violet Cascade\nPainted Skies by Hazel Winter\nThe Paradox of Our Love by Oceanic Odyssey\nThe Inescapable Gravity of Love by Zoe Mitchell\nBleeding Sun by Aria Sterling\nTrapped in a Daydream by Nova Harmony\nWaiting for the Morning Light by Grace Harrison\nVivid Scars by Lucas Grey\nHarmony of the Distant Stars by Lily Moon\nFleeting Touch by Mia Sullivan, Carter Knight\nBitter Haze by Marcus Lane\nSilent Sorrow by Aria Sterling\nThe Spiral of Unending Thoughts by Carter Knight"

# Split into lines, skip the header
lines = note_content.strip().split('\n')
songs = []
for line in lines[1:]:
    if ' by ' in line:
        title, artist = line.split(' by ', 1)
        songs.append({'title': title.strip(), 'artist': artist.strip()})
    else:
        # If no " by ", treat whole line as title
        songs.append({'title': line.strip(), 'artist': ''})

print(f"Parsed {len(songs)} songs")
print(songs[0])

# Search for the first song
spotify_token = spotify_login['access_token']
search_result = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=songs[0]['title'] + ' ' + songs[0]['artist'], access_token=spotify_token)
print(search_result)
